description: Endpoint for processing SKU model via URL. Accepts a URL parameter and appears to fetch external SKU model data. References external API at 127.0.0.1:4455. Leaks server IP and client IP information.
notes: CRITICAL INFORMATION DISCLOSURE: Page displays 'Your IP address: 172.18.0.1' and 'SKU model API: 127.0.0.1:4455'. URL parameter appears to be used for SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery) testing. POST requests don't trigger visible errors (unlike sku_add.php). External API endpoint is not responding (connection refused). Potential SSRF vulnerability if attacker can control the URL parameter to access internal services.
